priorityList: Cast Halo on cooldown for AoE damage.
Use Power Infusion and offensive trinkets, ideally aligned with Voidform or Entropic Rift.
Activate Voidform once Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are applied to your active targets.
Spend Insanity on Shadow Word: Madness to avoid capping or when Entropic Rift is active.
Cast Void Blast as your priority builder whenever it is available during Entropic Rift.
Use Tentacle Slam to apply or refresh Vampiric Touch on multiple targets or when charges are near capping.
Cast Void Torrent only when Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are already active on your targets.
Use Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health or to trigger Inescapable Torment while Shadowfiend or Mindbender is active.
Manually apply or refresh Vampiric Touch on targets (up to 12) if Tentacle Slam is unavailable.
Cast Mind Blast as your primary Insanity generator when Void Blast is not available.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity when the proc is active.
Use Shadow Word: Pain as a filler to spread dots or trigger Invoked Nightmare on priority targets.
Use Mind Flay as your primary filler, but interrupt it immediately for higher priority procs or cooldowns.
